original_test_intent: Measure PCIe bit error performance on the approved HGX link/lane set under the pinned NVQual BER stimulus and prove the observed errors over the tested bit population satisfy the authorized BER limit while the link, NVIDIA devices, and host remain stable without hang or unplanned reboot.
original_method: Pin the NVQual BER test identity, pattern/load, target path and lanes, generation/width, bit-count or duration and data-rate basis, counter start/end semantics, BER formula, acceptance/confidence rule, iterations, and any reset/power boundary; preserve baseline logs/counters; collect raw per-lane error and tested-bit evidence with topology/link/health state; abort on threshold or stability fault and recover out of band.
manual_activity: HGX owner/FAE supplies and approves the proprietary BER recipe, instrumentation/counter interpretation, threshold and any power/reset action; an operator isolates the SUT, supervises recovery, and adjudicates the measured BER artifact.
required_inputs: Pinned NVIDIA NVQual BER package, license, configuration, firmware, and driver compatibility
Exact HGX root-port/switch/retimer/endpoint/GPU/per-lane topology and target generation/width
Stimulus pattern/load, observation bits or duration with data-rate basis, raw counter sources, reset/wrap semantics, BER formula, limit, and confidence rule
Iteration count, permitted reset/power actions, persistent storage, abort, recovery, and final-state policy
safety_requirements: Dedicated non-production HGX SUT with explicit BER-stress and any reset/power authorization
No unsaved workload and verified BMC/console/power recovery
Export/hash baseline logs and counters; never erase pre-existing evidence merely to zero the view
Stop on BER limit breach, counter anomaly, lane/link downgrade, device loss, hang, unplanned reboot, new AER, thermal/power fault, tool failure, or evidence gap
No duration extension, power/reset loop, counter manipulation, or automatic retry after a fault
agent_execution_scope: Validate BER test identity, topology/lane mapping, counters, formula, baseline, interlocks, and storage
Run only the approved pattern, duration/bit population, iterations, and control boundaries
Preserve raw per-lane counters and tested-bit basis before computing BER
Correlate BER with link generation/width, device identity, AER, OS, GPU, BMC, thermal, and power health
Do not infer thresholds, substitute lspci for BER, clear evidence, retry faults, or issue the DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Approve NVQual BER recipe, path/lane scope, pattern, observation population, counter semantics, and any reset/power boundary
Define BER formula, per-lane/aggregate limit, confidence, iterations, link and system acceptance
Review raw counters/calculation/stability evidence and decide PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It correctly points to the vendor qualification family but verifies only link/device status; without raw errors and tested-bit population it cannot calculate or bound BER, and a final snapshot is not BER evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use only the pinned NVQual BER recipe and produce, per approved iteration and lane, immutable raw error counts, tested bits or rate-duration basis, counter semantics, calculated BER, threshold comparison, link state, and health evidence.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: NVQual Test #2 label, PCIe BER objective, all-items/no-hang/no-reboot Criteria, no bundle, and 5/15-minute estimates remain; no missing pattern, threshold, bit count, iteration, or reset behavior is invented.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Bind every raw error counter to a lane, start/end snapshot, observation-bit denominator, formula, configuration hash, and synchronized link/health timeline, retaining zeros as measured results rather than assumptions.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds the quantitative BER contract, per-lane counter provenance, confidence/threshold evaluation, stability interlocks, and recovery while preserving all source constraints.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A healthy final link or zero visible AER does not establish how many bits were observed, whether vendor BER counters accumulated errors, or whether counters wrapped/reset.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Short observations may not statistically support a stringent BER claim; destructive control or sustained high-rate patterns can destabilize GPUs/host and invalidate counter continuity.

project_override_considerations: If the vendor tool reports only PASS/FAIL, the owner must supply the pinned test definition showing pattern, duration/bit population, counters, threshold, and confidence behind that result. Do not reverse-engineer an unreported denominator or claim zero BER from a zero-error snapshot.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash plus owner-approved NVQual BER manifest and authorization
HGX/tool/firmware/driver/BMC identities and complete target path/per-lane topology
Pattern/load, bit-count or duration/data-rate basis, raw counter source/reset/wrap rules, formula, BER limit/confidence, iterations, and control policy
Per-iteration/per-lane raw start/end errors, observed bits, calculated BER, threshold result, timestamps, and link generation/width
First-fault recovery or clean final link/device/host state and engineer verdict

review_improvement: Makes BER a quantitative, auditable per-lane measurement instead of accepting generic link status, while retaining the source's no-hang/no-reboot stability gates and recovery boundary.
independent_technical_reasoning: BER is the number of observed bit errors divided by a defined tested-bit population; neither link presence nor an empty error grep supplies that denominator. Counter source, lane mapping, reset/wrap behavior, pattern, data rate, and observation duration determine whether the computed value is meaningful. A zero-error run only supports a bound whose confidence depends on observed bits. Thus raw immutable counters and denominator provenance are essential, and a failed/marginal run cannot be retried before its causal link and platform evidence are secured.
